name: Azeroth Circuit
notes: v2 (owner, 2026-10-04: 2 laps, shorter, bursty, more portals, literal jumps, Stormwind rooftops). Lap = Mirage Raceway start straight -> launch ramp into a portal -> Stormwind's outer wall walkway over the Valley of Heroes (roof-scan + roofpath.py, visible surfaces only) -> off the wall end into a mid-air portal -> Elwynn road -> crest ramp into a portal -> Westfall cobblestone road (trace-road WestFallCobbleStone) -> portal back to the raceway. v1 (the long Deadwind circuit) is course-v1.json.

ramp.name: raceway-launch
ramp.note: lip at x -6072 (width/2 past the end point); the portal stands 2 yd past the lip - 10 yd out, a launched kart had already dropped under the window (2026-10-04)

legs.name: Stormwind Wall
legs.routeSource: roof-scan sw-00 + roofpath.py (visible WMO surfaces only; Stormwind's roofs carry invisible collision planes)
legs.note: The wall runs into the mountain past (-8975, 320) (terrain 131..188 over a z-120 walkway): the leg starts mid-wall heading south-west and leaves over the NORTH-WEST edge (no parapet; valley floor ~77) into a portal 5 yd out. Route point 6 is the edge: racers jump there (jumps = route indices).

ramp.name: elwynn-crest
ramp.note: lip at y -328 (width/2 past the end); the portal hangs 9 yd past it

legs.name: Westfall Road
legs.routeSource: kart-course.py trace-road 0 -9880 975 -10260 1000 WestFallCobbleStone (0 yd off the painted road)

marshal.name: Zippa Sparkcog
marshal.title: Kart Race Marshal
marshal.greeting: Welcome to the Mirage Raceway, $c! Grab a kart and I'll put you on the grid. Three laps of the finest track in Azeroth - and I do mean ALL of Azeroth. Watch the portals.
